lines.text: Ooh, good part! Pinning the spot — three turns past the rust heap, left at the sad tire. All my landmarks are sad tires. The yard is full of them.

ft1Verdict.reason: Generic praise and filler could belong in any game; lacks scrapyard specificity.

lines.text: {biome}. New surface, no lap data yet. Give me one lap and I'll know where it bites.

ft1Verdict.reason: Military-vet tone, not a playful scrapyard robot peer.

lines.text: {biome}. Unmeasured ground. Pit rule one: respect what you haven't timed. Rule two: time it.

ft1Verdict.reason: Sounds like a grizzled military vet, not a playful scrapyard robot peer for kids.

lines.text: Ghost retired. By you. Your time's on the board now. The old one's still in my head — I keep everything. Ask me in a year.
Another ghost down. The board's thinning up top. One of these days the only name left to beat is yours. Plan for that day.
Dents out, frame's true. Straight frames make straight times. Nobody sets records on a bent one.
Another runner for the fleet. Bring it to the oval — corner two will introduce itself. I'll time the introduction.
lines.note: drift repair beyond the ft1 worst-15

lines.text: The oval's empty. Two stopwatches, zero laps. By pit math, that's overstaffed.
Repaired! You pressed the dent out flat — palm-smooth, the way the factory taught me. A flat panel is a happy panel. This one is very happy.
The bot is loved-on and race-day ready. A good repair leaves a seam, little one — and a good seam is stronger than the metal around it. Run your thumb across. That is your work, holding.
Rain on the roof, little builder — the yard is playing bench music. Warm light, dry tools, small builds. At the factory, rainy Tuesdays built the best cranes. I know. I lifted every one.
Hammer hour! I heard it from across the yard — three booms and a happy clank. That is the sound of a dent learning manners.
Whatever we choose, I will hold the heavy end. There are no small jobs, only small tools. I have the large ones.
Objection withdrawn IF we add a detour. Small one. Junk-sized. Through the good pile.
Yes to the plan! Yes yes yes. Also I brought snacks. Snack bolts. …They're regular bolts. Don't tell them.

ft1Verdict.reason: Generic filler repetition; no scrapyard specificity.
